crossRefs.note: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know…
Remember me, my God, for good, all that I have done for this people.
Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and…
I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify…
and for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.
With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in…
Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I…
for I was hungry, and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, and you gave me drink. I was a stranger, and you took me…
For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much…
For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that…
For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that…
Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you…
Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News…
For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with…
for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

translations.web: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
translations.bsb: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
translations.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he ➔ oft refreshed me, and was ➔ not ashamed of my chain:
translations.asv: The Lord grant mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus: for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;
